mapper.select: SELECT membership.user_id, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(o.organization_name ORDER BY LENGTH(o.organization_path) ASC SEPARATOR '·') FROM sys_organization o WHERE organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(o.organization_path, '%')) AS name FROM sys_user_organization membership JOIN sys_organization organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id WHERE membership.user_id IN #{userId} ORDER BY membership.user_id, organization.organization_name, organization.id

SELECT DISTINCT child.id FROM sys_user_organization membership JOIN sys_organization root ON root.id=membership.organization_id JOIN sys_organization child ON child.id=root.id OR (root.organization_path IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(root.organization_path)>0 AND LEFT(child.organization_path,CHAR_LENGTH(root.organization_path))=root.organization_path) WHERE membership.user_id=#{userId}

SELECT m.user_id, o.organization_name AS name FROM sys_user_organization m JOIN sys_organization o ON o.id=m.organization_id WHERE m.user_id IN #{id} AND m.organization_id IN #{id}AND 1=0 ORDER BY m.user_id,o.organization_name,o.id
